vb_textbox.text: There are two duos of pairs (brown and green & red and purple). They go through spells of one of the colours being higher. The mushrooms goes from 0 to 9. If you choose one and it gives 4+ mushrooms, stick with that colour (out of the 2) until it declines. Then switch. If the other colour then gives 4+ stick with it until it declines to 3 or less. If the other colour gives 3 or less immediately, try the other colour again to see which is higher.
